title: Ready Player Two
author: Ernest Cline
summary: Following on from Ready Player One, Wade Watts discovers a new technology that makes the virtual world feel completely real, along with a fresh hunt for hidden prizes. It is another pop-culture scavenger hunt with higher stakes.
readIf: you enjoyed the first book's 1980s references and want another round of puzzles and in-jokes.
skipIf: you have not read Ready Player One, or you want characters with more depth than nostalgia.

pairings.reason: The older, wilder ancestor of virtual-world fiction, with sharper satire and a faster pulse.
A newer game-like adventure with plenty of humour, built on survival and absurd rules.
A classic about a gifted kid inside a game that matters more than it seems.
